summary: A number with − / + steppers. For counts and small ranges.

pairs.dont: Use it for things that are digits but not quantities — a port, a PIN, a phone number.
pairs.why: Nobody increments a port. Steppers on an identifier invite an off-by-one that looks deliberate.

pairs.dont: Validate the range afterwards with an error message.
pairs.do: Set min and max, so the steppers stop and blur clamps.
pairs.why: A disabled + at the maximum says where the limit is before anyone hits it.

pairs.dont: Put the unit in the label only when the value is ambiguous.
pairs.do: Name the unit in the label — 'Timeout (seconds)'.
pairs.why: 3 what? Minutes and seconds differ by 60×, and the steppers make the number look precise.

a11y: role=spinbutton with aria-valuenow / min / max — what a native number input would announce, without its scroll-wheel and 'e' problems.
ArrowUp/Down step, PageUp/Down step ×10, Home/End jump to the bounds.
The steppers are tabIndex -1: keyboard users have the arrows, and two extra tab stops per field is a tax on every form.
